title: Build and verify the runner image for amd64 and arm64
description: The M1 image was only built and run on Docker Desktop arm64. Fargate Spot is cheapest on x86_64 (or Graviton arm64 at a lower price); decide the target architecture, build for it, and run the Linux Gherkin profile on that architecture.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Decision: ARM64 on Fargate; verified the arm64 image starts on Fargate (runner listening on 8080).

right_now_summary: The ARM64 image runs on Fargate, and the runner listens on port 8080.
